company.name: Blum
company.shortDescription: Blum is a decentralized exchange platform.
company.description: Blum offers a decentralized crypto trading platform built within a Telegram mini-app and a standalone app. The company enables multichain token trading across centralized and decentralized exchanges using tools like a trading terminal, Memepad, and AI-driven bots. It also facilitates token launches and manages live operations for its native $BLUM utility token. The platform provides digital tools for real-time market interaction, token farming mechanics, and integration within the TON ecosystem.
